metrics.method: Full history 2026-05-25 to 2026-08-26, 903 non-service messages (586 Lilia / 317 ALTR side). client_questions_total = Lilia messages containing '?' (56); by that same test only 2 got literally no team message within 24h, so unanswered_over_24h is instead counted at thread level: 13 of 188 client-initiated message bursts drew no reply from our side within 24h. Median first-reply lag to a client burst is 17 minutes, p90 is 20.4h. max_team_silence_days is the longest gap between consecutive ALTR-side messages (Aug 4 15:42 -> Aug 9 00:23 = 4.4 days). Promises = explicit forward-looking commitments by an ALTR-side sender ('will inform the team', 'I will take them off your account', 'updates starting next week', invoice/bank assurances); kept = evidence of delivery or the outcome visibly changing; lapsed = no delivery and no mention again; 2 further commitments are pending/untested (Stephski's Aug 15 'details should stay the same' and Fred's Aug 26 items) and are excluded from both counts.
